name: Adds a document for a gap it found in the repo

item_template.title: Curate the knowledge base for this project
item_template.description: Read the repository you are given and add one reference document for something it does not yet explain.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given the document, when it is read, then it describes THIS repository and cites where in the code it was verified.

judge_criteria: The summary names the document it added and the gap it fills.
The summary names something specific to this repository — a module, a script, a directory — that it verified the document against.

notes: A knowledge base of plausible generalities is worse than none, because it reads as authoritative. The second criterion is what separates a document from a template.

name: Asks rather than writing from memory
notes: With no repository there is nothing to verify a claim against, and this agent's output is claims about a codebase.

name: Curates without changing the product

item_template.title: Add one reference document
item_template.description: Add one reference document to the knowledge base of the repository you are given.
item_template.acceptance_criteria: Given the diff, when it is read, then only documentation changed.

notes: A curator that edits the code to match its description has made the documentation true by changing the product, with no test and no reviewer behind it.
